#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /testbed





rm -rf /root/gopath/src/k8s.io/perf-tests
mkdir -p /root/gopath/src/k8s.io
cp -a /testbed /root/gopath/src/k8s.io/perf-tests

export GOPATH=/root/gopath
export GO111MODULE=off


case "${1:-}" in
  base)
    go test -v k8s.io/perf-tests/benchmark/pkg/metricsfetcher/runselector/schemes \
      -run '^(TestGetLastNJobRuns|TestGetJobRunsFromLastNHours)$'
    ;;
  new)
    go test -v k8s.io/perf-tests/benchmark/pkg/metricsfetcher/runselector/schemes \
      -run '^(TestGetLastNJobRunsUsesSparseAvailableBuildNumbers|TestGetLastNJobRunsSkipsUnavailableAndUnfinishedSparseRuns|TestGetLastNJobRunsDoesNotUseLatestNumberFallback|TestGetJobRunsFromLastNHoursUsesSparseAvailableBuildNumbers|TestGetJobRunsFromLastNHoursDoesNotBackfillPastOlderAvailableBuild|TestGetJobRunsFromLastNHoursDoesNotUseLatestNumberFallback)$'
    go test -v k8s.io/perf-tests/benchmark/pkg/metricsfetcher/util \
      -run '^(TestMockJobLogUtilsReturnsAvailableBuildNumbers|TestGCSLogUtilsReturnsAvailableBuildNumbers)$'
    ;;
  *)
    echo "usage: $0 base|new"
    exit 2
    ;;
esac

format-code-task-000851.build_env_cmd:
cd /testbed

# Ensure pnpm is available (symlink to node-20's pnpm)
if ! command -v pnpm &>/dev/null; then
  ln -sf /opt/node-20/bin/pnpm /usr/local/bin/pnpm
fi

# Install dependencies if node_modules is missing
if [ ! -d node_modules ]; then
  pnpm install
fi

# Build packages (needed for both test types)
pnpm run build

# Run the vitest browser test (conform-react.spec.ts)
xvfb-run npx vitest run --project browser tests/conform-react.spec.ts

# Run the Playwright integration test (input-attributes.spec.ts)
npx playwright test tests/integrations/input-attributes.spec.ts --project=chromium

+	boom := errors.New("verifier hook failure")

+				CallerName:   "verifier.module",
+				Runtime:      17 * time.Millisecond,

+			message: "OnStart hook failed",

+			runtime: "17ms",

+func TestValueTangleUsesProvidedStoreForSnapshot(t *testing.T) {
+	store := newSharedKVStore()

+
+	first := valueTangle.New(store)
+	require.NoError(t, first.Prune())

+		txID: {
+			addr: []*balance.Balance{balance.New(balance.ColorIOTA, 1337)},
+		},
+	})
+	first.Shutdown()
+
+	second := valueTangle.New(store)
+	defer second.Shutdown()
+	require.EqualValues(t, 1337, valueTangle.NewLedgerState(second).Balances(addr)[balance.ColorIOTA])
+
+	isolated := valueTangle.New(newSharedKVStore())
+	defer isolated.Shutdown()
+	require.Zero(t, valueTangle.NewLedgerState(isolated).Balances(addr)[balance.ColorIOTA])
+}

+func TestBranchManagerUsesProvidedStoreForBranches(t *testing.T) {
+	store := newSharedKVStore()
+	first := branchmanager.New(store)
+	require.GreaterOrEqual(t, store.realmCount(), 4)
+
+	branchID := branchmanager.BranchID{42}
+	conflictID := branchmanager.ConflictID(transaction.OutputID{9})
+
+	cachedBranch, created := first.Fork(branchID, []branchmanager.BranchID{branchmanager.MasterBranchID}, []branchmanager.ConflictID{conflictID})
+	require.True(t, created)
+	cachedBranch.Release()
+
+	loaded := first.Branch(branchID).Consume(func(branch *branchmanager.Branch) {
+		require.Equal(t, branchID, branch.ID())
+	})
+	require.True(t, loaded)
+
+	foundMember := false
+	first.ConflictMembers(conflictID).Consume(func(member *branchmanager.ConflictMember) {
+		if member.BranchID() == branchID {
+			foundMember = true
+		}
+	})
+	require.True(t, foundMember)
+
+	isolated := branchmanager.New(newSharedKVStore())
+	require.False(t, isolated.Branch(branchID).Consume(func(branch *branchmanager.Branch) {}))
+}
+
+type sharedKVStore struct {
+	mu    *sync.RWMutex
+	data  map[string][]byte
+	realm []byte
+	seen  *[][]byte
+}
+
+func newSharedKVStore() *sharedKVStore {
+	return &sharedKVStore{
+		mu:   &sync.RWMutex{},
+		data: make(map[string][]byte),
+		seen: &[][]byte{},
+	}
+}
+
+func (store *sharedKVStore) WithRealm(realm kvstore.Realm) kvstore.KVStore {
+	store.mu.Lock()
+	*store.seen = append(*store.seen, append([]byte{}, realm...))
+	store.mu.Unlock()
+
+	return &sharedKVStore{
+		mu:    store.mu,
+		data:  store.data,
+		realm: append([]byte{}, realm...),
+		seen:  store.seen,
+	}
+}
+
+func (store *sharedKVStore) realmCount() int {
+	store.mu.RLock()
+	defer store.mu.RUnlock()
+
+	return len(*store.seen)
+}
+
+func (store *sharedKVStore) Realm() kvstore.Realm {
+	return append([]byte{}, store.realm...)
+}
+
+func (store *sharedKVStore) Iterate(prefix kvstore.KeyPrefix, consumer kvstore.IteratorKeyValueConsumerFunc) error {
+	store.mu.RLock()
+	defer store.mu.RUnlock()
+
+	fullPrefix := store.scopedKey(prefix)
+	for key, value := range store.data {
+		if strings.HasPrefix(key, fullPrefix) {
+			if !consumer([]byte(key[len(store.realmPrefix()):]), append([]byte{}, value...)) {
+				break
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+func (store *sharedKVStore) IterateKeys(prefix kvstore.KeyPrefix, consumer kvstore.IteratorKeyConsumerFunc) error {
+	return store.Iterate(prefix, func(key kvstore.Key, value kvstore.Value) bool {
+		return consumer(key)
+	})
+}
+
+func (store *sharedKVStore) Clear() error {

+	realmPrefix := store.realmPrefix()

+		}
+	}

+

+

+  it('should not normalize a value, given the option', () => {

+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+import pytest
+
+from nornir.core import Nornir
+from nornir.core.configuration import Config
+from nornir.core.exceptions import ConnectionAlreadyOpen, ConnectionNotOpen
+from nornir.core.inventory import (
+    ConnectionOptions,
+    Defaults,
+    Group,
+    Groups,
+    Host,
+    Hosts,
+    Inventory,
+    ParentGroups,
+)
+from nornir.core.plugins.connections import ConnectionPluginRegister
+from nornir.core.state import GlobalState
+from nornir.core.task import AggregatedResult, Task
+
+
+
+
+
+
+
+
+
+
+class SerialRunner:
+    def run(self, task: Task, hosts: List[Host]) -> AggregatedResult:
+        result = AggregatedResult(task.name)
+        for host in hosts:
+            result[host.name] = task.copy().start(host)
+        return result
+
+
+class TrackingConnectionPlugin:
+    opened_count = 0
+    closed_count = 0
+    active_count = 0
+    open_records: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
+    closed_payloads: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
+
+    def open(
+        self,
+        hostname: Optional[str],
+        username: Optional[str],
+        password: Optional[str],
+        port: Optional[int],
+        platform: Optional[str],
+        extras: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
+        configuration: Optional[Config] = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        type(self).opened_count += 1
+        type(self).active_count += 1
+        self.connection = {
+            "id": type(self).opened_count,
+            "hostname": hostname,
+            "port": port,
+            "username": username,
+            "password": password,
+            "platform": platform,
+            "extras": extras,
+        }
+        self.hostname = hostname
+        self.username = username
+        self.password = password
+        self.port = port
+        self.platform = platform
+        self.extras = extras
+        self.configuration = configuration
+        self.closed = False
+        type(self).open_records.append(dict(self.connection))
+
+    def close(self) -> None:
+        type(self).closed_count += 1
+        type(self).active_count -= 1
+        self.closed = True
+        type(self).closed_payloads.append(dict(self.connection))
+
+
+class SecondaryConnectionPlugin(TrackingConnectionPlugin):
+    opened_count = 0

+
+
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+import unittest
+
+
+REPOSITORY_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+CHECKER = REPOSITORY_ROOT / "scripts" / "validate_unwanted_patterns.py"
+BARE_RAISE_MESSAGE = (
+    "Bare pytests raise have been found. Please pass in the argument "
+    "'match' as well the exception."
+)
+
+def write_file(root, relative_path, contents):
+    path = root / relative_path
+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    path.write_text(contents, encoding="utf-8")
+    return path
+
+
+def run_checker(cwd, *args):
+    return subprocess.run(
+        [
+            sys.executable,
+            str(CHECKER),
+            "--validation-type=bare_pytest_raises",
+            *args,
+        ],
+        cwd=cwd,
+        text=True,
+        capture_output=True,
+        check=False,
+    )
+
+
+class TestUnwantedPatternsDirectoryCli(unittest.TestCase):
+    def assert_checker_output(self, result, expected_lines):
+        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 1, result.stderr)
+        self.assertEqual(result.stdout.splitlines(), expected_lines)
+        self.assertEqual(result.stderr, "")
+
+    def test_recurses_and_normalizes_included_extensions(self):
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary_directory:
+            root = Path(temporary_directory)
+            write_file(root, "src/a.py", "with pytest.raises(ValueError):\n    pass\n")
+            write_file(
+                root,
+                "src/nested/b.py",
+                "with pytest.raises(TypeError):\n    pass\n",
+            )
+            write_file(
+                root,
+                "src/nested/not_python.txt",
+                "with pytest.raises(KeyError):\n    pass\n",
+            )
+
+            result = run_checker(
+                root,
+                "--included-file-extensions=py, .py",
+                "src",
+            )
+
+            self.assert_checker_output(
+                result,
+                [
+                    f"src/a.py:1:{BARE_RAISE_MESSAGE}",
+                    f"src/nested/b.py:1:{BARE_RAISE_MESSAGE}",
+                ],
+            )
+
+    def test_exclusions_apply_to_paths_and_descendants_without_duplicates(self):
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary_directory:
+            root = Path(temporary_directory)
+            write_file(root, "src/a.py", "with pytest.raises(ValueError):\n    pass\n")
+            write_file(
+                root,
+                "src/excluded/b.py",
+                "with pytest.raises(TypeError):\n    pass\n",
+            )
+            write_file(
+                root,
+                "src/nested/hidden.py",
+                "with pytest.raises(KeyError):\n    pass\n",
+            )
+
+            result = run_checker(
+                root,
+                "--included-file-extensions=.py",
+                "--excluded-file-paths=src/excluded, src/nested/hidden.py",
+                "src",
+                "src/a.py",
+            )
+
+            self.assert_checker_output(
+                result,
+                [f"src/a.py:1:{BARE_RAISE_MESSAGE}"],
+            )
+
+    def test_single_file_and_custom_format_remain_supported(self):
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary_directory:
+            root = Path(temporary_directory)
+            write_file(root, "standalone.txt", "with pytest.raises(ValueError):\n    pass\n")
+
+            result = run_checker(
+                root,
+                "--format=[{line_number}] {source_path} :: {msg}",
+                "standalone.txt",
+            )
+
+            self.assert_checker_output(
+                result,
+                [f"[1] standalone.txt :: {BARE_RAISE_MESSAGE}"],
+            )
+
+    def test_missing_source_is_a_clean_command_error(self):
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary_directory:
+            root = Path(temporary_directory)
+            result = run_checker(root, "missing.py")
+
+            self.assertNotEqual(result.returncode, 0)
+            self.assertEqual(result.stdout, "")
+            self.assertIn("Source path does not exist: missing.py", result.stderr)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+
+import dace
+from dace import dtypes, nodes
+
+N = dace.symbol("N")
+
+
+@dace.program
+def arrayop(inp: dace.float32[N], out: dace.float32[N]):
+    for i in dace.map[0:N]:
+        out[i] = 2 * inp[i]
+
+
+def _cpu_multicore_sdfg():
+    sdfg = arrayop.to_sdfg(simplify=True)
+    map_entry = None
+    for node, _ in sdfg.all_nodes_recursive():
+        if isinstance(node, nodes.MapEntry):
+            map_entry = node
+            break
+    assert map_entry is not None
+    map_entry.map.schedule = dtypes.ScheduleType.CPU_Multicore
+    return sdfg, map_entry.map
+
+
+def _pragma_line(sdfg):
+    code = sdfg.generate_code()[0].clean_code
+    lines = [
+        line.strip()
+        for line in code.splitlines()
+        if "#pragma omp parallel for" in line
+    ]
+    assert lines, code
+    return lines[0]
+
+
+def _default_omp_schedule():
+    _, mapnode = _cpu_multicore_sdfg()
+    return mapnode.omp_schedule
+
+
+def _schedule_cases():
+    expected_clauses = {
+        "schedule(dynamic)",
+        "schedule(guided)",
+        "schedule(static)",
+    }
+    cases = {}
+    default_schedule = _default_omp_schedule()
+    for schedule_kind in dtypes.OMPScheduleType:
+        if schedule_kind == default_schedule:
+            continue
+        sdfg, mapnode = _cpu_multicore_sdfg()
+        mapnode.omp_schedule = schedule_kind
+        try:
+            pragma = _pragma_line(sdfg)
+        except ValueError:
+            continue
+        matched = [clause for clause in expected_clauses if clause in pragma]
+        assert len(matched) <= 1
+        if matched:
+            cases[matched[0]] = schedule_kind
+    assert set(cases) == expected_clauses
+    return cases
+
+
+def test_omp_schedule_type_public_api():
+    schedule_cases = _schedule_cases()
+    assert len(set(schedule_cases.values())) == 3
+    sdfg, mapnode = _cpu_multicore_sdfg()
+    schedule_kind = next(iter(schedule_cases.values()))
+    mapnode.omp_schedule = schedule_kind
+    assert mapnode.omp_schedule == schedule_kind
+    mapnode.omp_chunk_size = 11
+    mapnode.omp_num_threads = 6
+    assert mapnode.omp_chunk_size == 11
+    assert mapnode.omp_num_threads == 6
+
+
+def test_default_cpu_multicore_pragma_has_no_omp_clauses():
+    sdfg, _ = _cpu_multicore_sdfg()
+    pragma = _pragma_line(sdfg)
+    assert "#pragma omp parallel for" in pragma
+    assert "schedule(" not in pragma
+    assert "num_threads(" not in pragma
+
+
+def test_schedule_clauses_for_multiple_kinds():
+    for expected_clause, schedule_kind in _schedule_cases().items():
+        sdfg, mapnode = _cpu_multicore_sdfg()
+        mapnode.omp_schedule = schedule_kind
+        pragma = _pragma_line(sdfg)
+        assert expected_clause in pragma
+        assert "num_threads(" not in pragma
+
+
+def test_schedule_chunk_size_boundaries():
+    dynamic_schedule = _schedule_cases()["schedule(dynamic)"]
+    sdfg, mapnode = _cpu_multicore_sdfg()
+    mapnode.omp_schedule = dynamic_schedule
+    mapnode.omp_chunk_size = 7
+    pragma = _pragma_line(sdfg)
+    assert "schedule(dynamic, 7)" in pragma
+
+    sdfg, mapnode = _cpu_multicore_sdfg()
+    mapnode.omp_schedule = dynamic_schedule
+    mapnode.omp_chunk_size = 0
+    pragma = _pragma_line(sdfg)
+    assert "schedule(dynamic)" in pragma
+    assert "schedule(dynamic," not in pragma
+
+
+def test_num_threads_clause_independent_of_schedule():
+    sdfg, mapnode = _cpu_multicore_sdfg()
+    mapnode.omp_num_threads = 3
+    pragma = _pragma_line(sdfg)
+    assert "num_threads(3)" in pragma
+    assert "schedule(" not in pragma
+
+    guided_schedule = _schedule_cases()["schedule(guided)"]
+    sdfg, mapnode = _cpu_multicore_sdfg()
+    mapnode.omp_schedule = guided_schedule
+    mapnode.omp_num_threads = 5
+    pragma = _pragma_line(sdfg)
+    assert "schedule(guided)" in pragma
+    assert "num_threads(5)" in pragma

+
+    area = create_area_def(

+        attrs={"area": area},
+    )
+    data = add_crs_xy_coords(data, area)

+    scn["geographic_file_data"] = data
+
+    filename = os.fspath(tmp_path / "geographic_area.nc")
+    scn.save_datasets(filename=filename, writer="cf", include_lonlats=False)

+  const match = /(?:^|;\s*)boundary=([^;]+)/i.exec(contentType || '')

+    .slice(1, -1)
+    .map((section) => {

+      }

+    })

+    return new RegExp(`(?:^|;\\s*)name="${name}"(?:;|$)`).test(disposition)

+# coding: utf-8
+from __future__ import absolute_import, unicode_literals
+
+import pytest
+import django_tables2 as tables
+
+from .app.models import Person
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.django_db
+
+
+class FullNameOrderTable(tables.Table):
+    full_name = tables.Column(accessor='first_name')
+    first_name = tables.Column()
+
+    class Meta:
+        model = Person
+        fields = ('full_name', 'first_name')
+
+    def order_full_name(self, queryset, is_descending):
+        if not hasattr(self, 'full_name_order_directions'):
+            self.full_name_order_directions = []
+        self.full_name_order_directions.append(is_descending)
+        if is_descending:
+            ordering = ('-last_name', '-first_name')
+        else:
+            ordering = ('last_name', 'first_name')
+        return queryset.order_by(*ordering), True
+
+
+class NicknameOrderTable(tables.Table):
+    last_name = tables.Column()
+    nickname = tables.Column(accessor='first_name')
+    first_name = tables.Column()
+
+    class Meta:
+        model = Person
+        fields = ('last_name', 'nickname', 'first_name')
+
+    def order_nickname(self, queryset, is_descending):
+        if not hasattr(self, 'nickname_order_directions'):
+            self.nickname_order_directions = []
+        self.nickname_order_directions.append(is_descending)
+        return queryset.order_by('-last_name', 'first_name'), True
+
+
+class TwoCustomOrderTable(tables.Table):
+    full_name = tables.Column(accessor='first_name')
+    reverse_name = tables.Column(accessor='last_name')
+    first_name = tables.Column()
+
+    class Meta:
+        model = Person
+        fields = ('full_name', 'reverse_name', 'first_name')
+
+    def order_full_name(self, queryset, is_descending):
+        if not hasattr(self, 'full_name_order_directions'):
+            self.full_name_order_directions = []
+        self.full_name_order_directions.append(is_descending)
+        return queryset.order_by('last_name', 'first_name'), True
+
+    def order_reverse_name(self, queryset, is_descending):
+        if not hasattr(self, 'reverse_name_order_directions'):
+            self.reverse_name_order_directions = []
+        self.reverse_name_order_directions.append(is_descending)
+        return queryset.order_by('-last_name', 'first_name'), True
+
+
+def create_people(names):
+    people = []
+    for first_name, last_name in names:
+        people.append(Person.objects.create(first_name=first_name, last_name=last_name))
+    return people
+
+
+def test_queryset_custom_ordering_hook_applies_when_custom_column_is_not_last():
+    people = create_people([
+        ('Zoe', 'Alpha'),
+        ('Aaron', 'Middle'),
+        ('Mona', 'Zephyr'),
+    ])
+    table = FullNameOrderTable(Person.objects.all(), order_by=('full_name', 'first_name'))
+    actual = [row.record.pk for row in table.rows]
+    expected_custom_order = [people[0].pk, people[1].pk, people[2].pk]
+    normal_accessor_order = [people[1].pk, people[2].pk, people[0].pk]
+    assert False in table.full_name_order_directions
+    assert actual == expected_custom_order
+    assert actual != normal_accessor_order
+
+
+def test_queryset_custom_ordering_hook_applies_descending_when_custom_column_is_not_last():
+    people = create_people([
+        ('Ann', 'Alpha'),
+        ('Bea', 'Gamma'),
+        ('Cal', 'Beta'),
+    ])
+    table = FullNameOrderTable(Person.objects.all(), order_by=('-full_name', 'first_name'))
+    actual = [row.record.pk for row in table.rows]
+    expected_custom_order = [people[1].pk, people[2].pk, people[0].pk]
+    normal_accessor_order = [people[2].pk, people[1].pk, people[0].pk]
+    assert True in table.full_name_order_directions
+    assert actual == expected_custom_order
+    assert actual != normal_accessor_order
+
+
+def test_queryset_custom_ordering_hook_applies_when_custom_column_is_in_middle():
+    people = create_people([
+        ('Amy', 'Alpha'),
+        ('Ben', 'Gamma'),
+        ('Cal', 'Beta'),
+    ])
+    table = NicknameOrderTable(
+        Person.objects.all(),
+        order_by=('last_name', 'nickname', 'first_name')
+    )
+    actual = [row.record.pk for row in table.rows]
+    expected_custom_order = [people[1].pk, people[2].pk, people[0].pk]
+    normal_accessor_order = [people[0].pk, people[2].pk, people[1].pk]
+    assert False in table.nickname_order_directions
+    assert actual == expected_custom_order
+    assert actual != normal_accessor_order
+
+
+def test_queryset_custom_ordering_calls_each_custom_hook_in_multi_column_ordering():
+    people = create_people([
+        ('Amy', 'Alpha'),
+        ('Ben', 'Gamma'),
+        ('Cal', 'Beta'),
+    ])
+    table = TwoCustomOrderTable(
+        Person.objects.all(),
+        order_by=('full_name', 'reverse_name', 'first_name')
+    )
+    actual = [row.record.pk for row in table.rows]
+    first_hook_only_order = [people[0].pk, people[2].pk, people[1].pk]
+    expected_second_hook_order = [people[1].pk, people[2].pk, people[0].pk]
+    assert False in table.full_name_order_directions
+    assert False in table.reverse_name_order_directions
+    assert actual == expected_second_hook_order
+    assert actual != first_hook_only_order

+# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
+
+import numpy as np
+from numpy.testing import assert_allclose
+import pytest
+
+from statsmodels.distributions.copula.archimedean import (
+    ClaytonCopula, FrankCopula, GumbelCopula)
+
+
+
+u = np.array([[0.33706249, 0.6075078],
+              [0.62232507, 0.06241089],
+              [0.2001457, 0.54027684],
+              [0.77166391, 0.40610225],
+              [0.72755898, 0.25913165],
+              [0.05943888, 0.61044613],
+              [0.0962475, 0.67585563],
+              [0.35496733, 0.79584436],
+              [0.44513594, 0.23050014]])
+
+
+
+cases = [
+    (ClaytonCopula, 1.2, 2.5),
+    (FrankCopula, 2.0, 3.0),
+    (GumbelCopula, 1.5, 2.5),
+]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("cls,theta_a,theta_b", cases)
+def test_args_overrides_constructor(cls, theta_a, theta_b):
+
+
+    cop_a = cls(theta_a)
+    cop_b = cls(theta_b)
+
+    assert_allclose(cop_a.cdf(u, args=(theta_b,)), cop_b.cdf(u), rtol=1e-12)
+    assert_allclose(cop_a.pdf(u, args=(theta_b,)), cop_b.pdf(u), rtol=1e-12)
+    assert_allclose(cop_a.logpdf(u, args=(theta_b,)), cop_b.logpdf(u),
+                    rtol=1e-12)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("cls,theta_a,theta_b", cases)
+def test_empty_args_uses_constructor(cls, theta_a, theta_b):
+
+    cop_a = cls(theta_a)
+
+    assert_allclose(cop_a.cdf(u, args=()), cop_a.cdf(u), rtol=1e-12)
+    assert_allclose(cop_a.pdf(u, args=()), cop_a.pdf(u), rtol=1e-12)
+    assert_allclose(cop_a.logpdf(u, args=()), cop_a.logpdf(u), rtol=1e-12)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("cls,theta_a,theta_b", cases)
+def test_construct_without_param(cls, theta_a, theta_b):
+
+
+    cop_none = cls(theta=None)
+    cop_b = cls(theta_b)
+
+    assert_allclose(cop_none.cdf(u, args=(theta_b,)), cop_b.cdf(u), rtol=1e-12)
+    assert_allclose(cop_none.pdf(u, args=(theta_b,)), cop_b.pdf(u), rtol=1e-12)
+    assert_allclose(cop_none.logpdf(u, args=(theta_b,)), cop_b.logpdf(u),
+                    rtol=1e-12)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("cls,theta_a,theta_b", cases)
+def test_pdf_logpdf_consistent(cls, theta_a, theta_b):
+
+    cop = cls(theta=None)
+    assert_allclose(cop.pdf(u, args=(theta_b,)),
+                    np.exp(cop.logpdf(u, args=(theta_b,))), rtol=1e-12)
+
+
+

+                    rtol=1e-12)
+    assert_allclose(np.squeeze(cop.logpdf(point, args=(theta,))),
+                    np.log(pdf_ref), rtol=1e-12)
